description.value: You conjure a pseudopod of acidic ooze that slams a creature or object within range. Make a melee spell attack. On hit, the target takes 8d4 acid damage and is moved 5 feet in a direction of your choice.\n\n

higher_level_description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 2d4 for each slot level above 2nd.
